description: Sri Lanka Customs - Approved and appointed Transco International Cargo Service (Pvt.) Limited as an Unaccompanied Passenger Baggage Bonded Warehouse
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes regulatory approval for bonded warehouses under the Customs Ordinance, specifically creating a legal framework for unaccompanied passenger baggage handling. It exercises statutory powers granted by legislation (Customs Ordinance Chapter 235) and creates binding regulatory requirements, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or organizational change.
